cns.text: Muzzio, a visionary artificer of Paliano, is rejected by the Board of Senior Advisors in his motion to become vice chancellor, as they elect Tulando instead, amid rumors that he serves the Black Rose and killed Daretti.
Upset at losing the vote, he summons his apprentice Irie to his hidden workshop, which holds an army of constructs and a scale model of Paliano, and denies ever having killed anyone.

He explains his grand design to mitigate human variables and says that the death of Brago and his seeming ascension made the board vote more cautiously, though in the end, with the others gone, the board carries Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor.
